title: Realization square for the actual integral compositor
statement: For a ComparisonFamily C pinned by IsFactorized and a Q_l-algebra equivalence e:E≃Q_l, let A=C.coefficient E and a:E→Omega be its composite with the canonical embedding. For arbitrary separated finite-type k-schemes X,Y,Z and k-morphisms f,g, compactifications cf,cg,ch, intervening compactification d, common refinement c and legs r,s as in [def-pur-condensed-compositor-realization-data], and uniform integral K, the exact equality U_Z(integralCompositor_K) ≫ comparison_h(K) = comparison_g(P_f K) ≫ F_g(comparison_f(K)) ≫ condensedCompositor(U_X K) holds. This asserts only the realization square, not invertibility, naturality, refinement, or independence. The comparison family C, its coefficient data and the comparisons are those of [lem-pur-compact-support-condensed-realization]; F_g is the condensed derived lower shriek of the compactification cg [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-lower-shriek]. Dependencies: [def-pur-condensed-compositor-realization-data], [def-pur-compact-support-realization-factorization], [lem-pur-compact-support-condensed-realization], [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-lower-shriek].

lean.statement: theorem condensedCompositorRealizationSquare (C : ComparisonFamily l k) (hC : CompactSupportRealizationFactorization.IsFactorized l k C) (e : E ≃ₐ[ℚ_[l]] ℚ_[l]) (X Y Z : CondensedERealization.Base k) (f : X.scheme ⟶ Y.scheme) (g : Y.scheme ⟶ Z.scheme) [f.IsOver (Spec (.of k))] [g.IsOver (Spec (.of k))] (cf : Compactification f) (cg : Compactification g) (ch : Compactification (f ≫ g)) (d : Compactification (cf.g ≫ cg.i)) (c : Compactification (f ≫ g)) (r : c.Refinement (composite k X Y Z f g cf cg d)) (s : c.Refinement ch) (K : CondensedERealization.Integral l E X.scheme) (hK : Uniform l E k X K) : let A := C.coefficient E let a := (Algebra.ofId ℚ_[l] (PadicAlgCl l)).comp e.toAlgHom (U l E k A a Z).map (integralCompositor l E k A X Y Z f g cf cg ch d c r s K hK) ≫ comparison l E k A a X Z (f ≫ g) ch K = comparison l E k A a Y Z g cg ((P l E k A X Y f cf).obj K) ≫ (CondensedRing.rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification (Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj l) cg).map (comparison l E k A a X Y f cf K) ≫ ((condensedCompositor l k X Y Z f g cf cg ch).hom.app ⟨(U l E k A a X).obj K, U_constructible l E k A a X K⟩).hom
